bar-label: What fills the drive, by kind of file
done-shrink.one: Shrank {{count}} folder and saved {{size}}. It opens just as before.
done-shrink.other: Shrank {{count}} folders and saved {{size}}. They open just as before.
done-restore: Restored. The folder takes {{size}} more again.
done-trash.one: Moved {{count}} item to the Recycle Bin. You can put it back from there.
done-trash.other: Moved {{count}} items to the Recycle Bin. You can put them back from there.
done-empty: Emptied the Recycle Bin and freed {{size}}.
skipped.one: {{count}} file was in use and was left as it was.
skipped.other: {{count}} files were in use and were left as they were.
stopped-shrink: Stopped after {{done}} of {{total}} folders. The finished ones saved {{size}}; the rest are as they were.
stopped: Stopped after {{done}} of {{total}}. The rest are as they were.
hint-caches: Caches are best emptied from Clean, which knows what each app rebuilds.
hint-shrink: These can get smaller without deleting anything.
slow-not-admin: Without administrator rights, Silt opened every folder instead of reading the drive's index. As administrator the same scan takes seconds.
slow-not-ntfs: This drive isn't NTFS, so Silt opened every folder instead of reading the drive's index.
failed-elsewhere: There's nothing to show until the drive is read. Try again from Overview.
scanning-later: Each colour is a kind of file. They sort themselves out as soon as the scan finishes.
scanning-elsewhere: This fills in as soon as the scan finishes.
reclaim-shrink.one: {{count}} folder can be stored compressed. Nothing is deleted.
reclaim-shrink.other: {{count}} folders can be stored compressed. Nothing is deleted.
reclaim-clean.one: {{count}} cache that its app rebuilds on its own
reclaim-clean.other: {{count}} caches that apps rebuild on their own
reclaim-large.one: {{count}} file over {{size}}, untouched for six months
reclaim-large.other: {{count}} files over {{size}}, untouched for six months
confirm-bin.one: Delete {{count}} item ({{size}}) for good? This can't be undone.
confirm-bin.other: Delete {{count}} items ({{size}}) for good? This can't be undone.
clean-sub: Caches and leftovers that apps and Windows rebuild on their own. Cleaning them doesn't touch your files or settings.
clean-empty-body: No cache Silt knows about is taking space right now.
confirm-clean.one: Clean {{count}} cache and free {{size}}? Its app rebuilds what it needs.
confirm-clean.other: Clean {{count}} caches and free {{size}}? Apps rebuild what they need.
algo-fast-note: XPRESS 4K. Saves the least and costs nothing you'd notice.
algo-balanced-note: XPRESS 8K. A good saving with no slowdown on today's processors.
algo-smaller-note: XPRESS 16K. A little more saving for a little more work when files are read.
algo-smallest-note: LZX. The biggest saving, best for apps you open now and then.
shrink-sub: Windows can store these folders compressed. They open and run exactly as before, nothing is deleted, and Restore puts them back as they were.
shrink-empty-body: The apps, games and tools here are already compressed or too small to be worth it.
large-sub: The biggest files on {{drive}}. What you pick goes to the Recycle Bin, so you can put it back.
category-sub-reclaim: {{size}} on {{drive}}. {{reclaim}} of it can be reclaimed.
confirm-trash.one: Move {{count}} item ({{size}}) to the Recycle Bin?
confirm-trash.other: Move {{count}} items ({{size}}) to the Recycle Bin?
system-hands-off: Windows manages these. Silt shows them so you know where the space went, and leaves them alone.
large-empty-body: No file matches these filters. Try a smaller size or a shorter time.
category-empty-body: No single item in this category is big enough to list on its own.
folder-empty-body: Nothing in it takes space on disk.
map-label: This folder's contents as tiles sized by space
history-sub: Everything Silt has changed on this PC. Shrunk folders can be restored to how they were.
history-empty-body: When you shrink, clean or move files to the Recycle Bin, each change is listed here, and shrinks can be undone.
did-trash.one: Moved {{count}} item to the Recycle Bin
did-trash.other: Moved {{count}} items to the Recycle Bin
settings-sub: How Silt looks and works on this PC.
set-language-note: Silt follows Windows unless you pick one here.
set-theme-note: Light, dark, or whichever Windows is using.
set-admin-note: As administrator, Silt reads the drive's index and a scan takes seconds. Without it, Silt opens every folder, which takes minutes, and a few stay closed to it.
about-journal: Free and open source under MIT or Apache 2.0. Every change Silt makes is written to a journal on this PC, and History reads it from there.
estimating-body: Silt reads a few blocks of each kind of file to see how well it compresses. Folders appear here as soon as they are measured.
